raw.details:
Overview

HackNexus is a student-focused online hackathon organised by Mastermind Research Technologies. Participants will develop innovative AI-integrated solutions to address real-world challenges in the healthcare sector.

Eligibility

  • Open to students from all colleges, courses, and branches.
  • Participants may register individually or in teams of up to 2 members.
  • Inter-college and inter-specialisation teams are allowed.
  • Each participant may be part of only one team.

Format

  • The hackathon will be conducted online.
  • Participants will receive healthcare-focused problem statements.
  • Teams will develop and submit their proposed solution or prototype within the given timeline.
  • Shortlisted teams will participate in a final presentation and pitching round.

Rounds

  • Registration and team formation
  • Idea/abstract submission
  • Shortlisting of teams
  • Final hackathon and project development
  • Jury evaluation and result announcement

Evaluation Criteria

  • Innovation and originality
  • Relevance to the problem statement
  • Effective use of AI
  • Technical implementation
  • Practical feasibility and potential impact
  • Quality of presentation

Rules

  • All submissions must be original work created for this hackathon.
  • The use of AI tools is allowed.
  • Use of pre-built projects, copied work, or plagiarism will result in disqualification.
  • Participants must follow all instructions shared by the organising team.
  • The decision of the organisers and jury will be final.
  • Detailed schedules, problem statements, and submission guidelines will be shared with registered participants.

Prizes and Opportunities

  • Certificate of participation/achievement for eligible participants.
  • Selected participants may receive remote internship opportunities with Mastermind Research Technologies.
